# Clear Sites Web Agency
> Websites, local SEO, AI search (GEO), ads, review requests and CRMs for small and local businesses nationwide. Based in Michigan.

## Key facts
- Name: Clear Sites Web Agency
- What we do: websites, local SEO, AI search (GEO), Google and Facebook ads, review requests, Speed-to-Lead follow-up and CRMs for small and local businesses
- Where: based in Canton, Michigan; works with clients across the United States by phone, video and email
- Phone: 904-566-9797
- Email: getcleardeskai@gmail.com
- Website: https://clearsiteswebagency.com/
- Pricing: published at https://clearsiteswebagency.com/pricing/ (websites from $500 setup plus a monthly care plan; plans are month to month)
- Last updated: 2026-11-05
